h: Pursuing Justice and Receiving an Inheritance That Lasts

p: "Righteousness, righteousness shall you pursue, that you may live
אֲשֶׁר ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ נוֹתֵן לָךְ (דְּבָרִים טז, כ)
which Hashem your God gives you" (Devarim 16:20).
"This teaches that the appointment of judges
is worthy to give life to Yisrael
and to settle them on their land,
and not to let them fall by the sword."
The words "and not to let them fall by the sword"
and likewise in Rashi's commentary it is not brought,
and in the new printings they erased it.
It is more plausible to emend:
"and to let their enemies fall by the sword";
and this is alluded to in what is said,
who is the Master of your powers,
gives it to you as a gift,
and the kelipos fall by the sword.
וְעַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ)
And according to what they said in the holy Zohar (on this parshah):
'For My sword is sated in heaven;
behold, it shall come down upon Edom.'
The sword of the Holy One, blessed be He:
Yud is the head of the sword,
Vav is the body of the sword,
the two Heis are its two edges."
And this is what it said:
"and to let their enemies fall by the sword,"
which is the sword of the Holy One, blessed be He,
And this is what the pasuk said, "that you may live":
that it be like an inheritance that has no interruption
is by way of a gift,
that the holiness of the Land
be fixed in the heart forever.
correspond to the three holinesses of the Avos.
הוּא נֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
with whom the two thousand years of Torah began;
who brought down the words of Torah
and was an elder sitting in the academy
הוּא נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
who was the first to be circumcised at eight days;
"And your people shall all be righteous;
they shall inherit the land forever";
"and although there are many guilty ones,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק א צג, א וְעוֹד)
(as is written in Zohar I 93a and elsewhere).
הוּא נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
and he is a chariot for the Name Havayah,
חַרְבָּא דְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
the sword of the Holy One, blessed be He, as mentioned above;
וּבָזֶה כָּל הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת נוֹפְלִין
and by this all the idolaters fall,
"and a double-edged sword in their hand,
to execute vengeance upon the nations."
And likewise all the kelipos fall
by the sword of the Holy One, blessed be He,
as is written in the holy Zohar.
נִדְרָשׁ עַל קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע שֶׁעַל מִטָּתוֹ
it is expounded about the reading of Shema at bedtime,
"the harmful spirits keep away from him."
וְזֶה קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this is the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"The lip of truth shall be established forever";
so that all his offspring will also be
who was like Adam HaRishon before the corruption;
and this will be in the days of Mashiach,
and then it will become clear:
"And your people shall all be righteous;
they shall inherit the land forever";
and the evil inclination will be nullified
And on Shabbos, which is a semblance of the World to Come,
one sixtieth of the World to Come,
to feel a semblance of the World to Come;
and one who merits the Supernal Shabbos,
שֶׁיְּהֵא אִתְפַּנֵּי יֵצֶר הָרָע מִן תַּמָּן
where the evil inclination is cleared away from there
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב תִּקּוּנֵי זֹהַר תִּקּוּן מח, פה, א)
(as is written in Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48, 85a)
הוּא בִּפְרָט יוּכַל לִהְיוֹת נִגְאָל מִיָּד
he in particular can be redeemed immediately.
